ayahOccurrences.text: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: لَنَسْفَعًۢا is in the derivative form: نسفع
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/ف/ع   s–f–ʿ to taint black with other colours (in particular white), to slap with the open hand or (of a bird) with a wing; to drag along. Of this root, only نَسْفَع nasfaʿ occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
نسفع nasfaʿ [imperf. of v. سَفِع safiʿa, intrans.] to drag, to seize, to grab

(96:15) كَلاَّ لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ لَنَسْفَعَنْ بِالنَّاصِيَةِ no indeed!, if he does not desist, We shall seize [him] by the forelock (or, smack him on the forehead).
